project_name: DisruptRadar SaaS - Agente de Inteligência Competitiva
archetype: Swiss High-Contrast & Tactical Obsidian Intelligence (VC / Corporate Dev Deal Flow)
emotional_tone: Tactical precision, authoritative intelligence, high-density clarity, executive urgency
theme_preference: Dark Mode First (Obsidian Vault aesthetic with deep #090A0F canvas and crisp micro-borders)

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight font-display
hierarchy.subtitle: text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-400 font-normal leading-relaxed
hierarchy.overline: text-xs font-mono font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-emerald-400/80

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 lg:gap-6

bento_spans.metrics_summary: col-span-full lg:col-span-12 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4

components.workspace_switcher: Shadcn Select customized with workspace icons, domain counter badges, and create workspace modal
components.watchlist_table: Dense data table with company domain, tags, headcount status, delta percentage badge, risk badge (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), last run timestamp, and quick trigger actions
components.run_now_button: Pill button with dynamic scan pulse effect, active polling step indicators (plan -> fetch -> analyze -> verify -> risk -> report)
components.risk_badge: High contrast pill with status dot: LOW (emerald), MEDIUM (amber), HIGH (crimson with pulse halo)
components.headcount_time_series_chart: Recharts ResponsiveContainer AreaChart with dual lines (headcount actual vs baseline prediction), custom glass tooltip, and interval toggles (7D, 30D, 90D, 1Y)
components.executive_report_rendered: Structured markdown preview panel with AI executive summary, key risk flags, headcount delta analysis, social signals, and export PDF / Slack share buttons
components.slack_integration_panel: Webhook URL config, notification rules (Risk >= MEDIUM, Headcount delta > 10%), live test notification trigger with status feedback
components.run_history_timeline: Vertical stepper timeline showing execution duration, trace links, status (SUCCESS/FAILED), logs expansion panel

motion_and_interactions.run_polling_animation: Step-by-step radar beacon highlight (plan -> fetch -> analyze -> verify -> risk -> report) with active spinner and live trace log stream
motion_and_interactions.chart_hover: Smooth active dot scaling + crosshair line + frosted glass custom tooltip with delta comparison
motion_and_interactions.card_hover: Border glow transition from #1E2436 to #333D5C with subtle 2px Y-axis lift
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Sonner toast notifications on watch additions, domain analysis completed, Slack webhook tested, export downloaded

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: All text elements adhere to APCA/WCAG AA standards on dark background (#08090E)
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_policy: All interactive buttons, inputs, filter tabs, company table rows, risk badges, run actions, workspace selectors MUST include explicit role-based data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='run-analysis-button', data-testid='watchlist-domain-input', data-testid='risk-badge-high')
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_nav: Full dialog and tab navigation accessibility via keyboard focus rings

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 6-stage intelligence agent pipeline loop visually: plan -> fetch -> analyze -> verify -> risk -> report.

Provide demo mock datasets for top VC targets (e.g., AI startups, FinTech scaleups, DevTools) with real domain watchlist items, tags, headcount historical data points, and generated executive reports.
Include workspace switcher functionality (e.g., 'Fund I - Early Stage', 'Corporate Dev - Cybersecurity', 'SaaS Benchmark')
Ensure 'Analisar agora' button triggers live simulation of polling pipeline with realistic progress steps and immediate UI update.
Include headcount time-series interactive chart using Recharts with date range toggle.
Render rich formatted executive report view with key findings, risk assessment, talent growth velocity, and Slack push status.
Use Sonner for toast notifications and ensure code uses custom dark high-contrast theme classes.
